selection: power=substation (nodes, ways, relations); power=line (ways); power=minor_line|cable with voltage (ways)
stationGeometry: OSM node or bounding box center, not an electrical connection point
lineGeometry: OSM geometry simplified with tolerance 0.00003 degrees
completeness: All matching objects in the Germany extract, not a complete inventory of physical infrastructure

enrichment.method: Uniquely contained transformer nodes in valid closed OSM station ways; no nearest-neighbour assignment, no inferred station voltage or free capacity. Relations and unlocated equipment not covered.
